spec2def(dbgeng.dll dbgeng.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# dbgeng.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dbgeng-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(dbgeng_shims OBJECT dbgeng.c)
target_link_libraries(dbgeng_shims PRIVATE wine libpsapi libmsvcrt libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(dbgeng_shims)
add_cargo_module(dbgeng dbgeng-cargo dbgeng.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dbgeng_shims psdk)
